prompts: Create a production game texture atlas, NOT a mockup or scene. Reference image ONLY establishes muted Chinese hand-painted ink/gouache art style compatible with its illustrated tree. Output exactly 1024 wide x 2048 tall, a tightly packed 2 column x 4 row grid of EIGHT equal square texture swatches, no gutters, no borders, no labels, no text, no perspective, no cubes. Each square completely filled opaque, painted flat diffuse/albedo, no cast shadows or baked highlights. LEFT COLUMN is overhead ground; RIGHT COLUMN is corresponding vertical cliff material, rendered flat front-on. ROW1 forest grass ground / earthy cliff with restrained moss near top; ROW2 fallen leaves on forest soil / warm compact earth and understated sediment; ROW3 natural solid rock bedrock / matching rock cliff with same mineral palette, NOT paving stones, NOT masonry; ROW4 quiet jade water overhead / damp bedrock bank, NOT a tall wall of water. Upper/lower materials must share palette but do not stretch top into vertical fringes; NO grass fringe, NO decorative trim or ledge, NO hanging blades along an entire border. Side squares may have subtle top-to-bottom material transition but no black fade: fading is done by engine. Quiet texture at game scale, avoid evenly scattered dots, avoid photographic noise. VARIANT 1: aged mineral pigments and restrained Chinese storybook gouache. Muted olive and moss greens, warm umber soil, grey-ochre bedrock, dark jade water. Broad irregular color masses, small sparse leaf shapes, thin hand-inked natural cracks, elegant and subdued, closest to reference existing art.
